extracted.intended_audience: Wattpad writers and creators (aspiring and active authors on Wattpad)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for producing, promoting, and protecting stories on the Wattpad platform, with emphasis on community engagement, craft improvement, copyright awareness, and monetization opportunities. Targets authors who want to grow readership and participate in Wattpad programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social activity / community engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Social activity is the key to success on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Making friends is one of the best ways to gain readership because friends read friends' stories. Social activity helps you forge connections that can be beneficial in a business sense and may result in valuable advice or support from broad communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific engagement tactics to gain readers
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical actions to encourage Wattpadders to read your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Start by following other writers and reading their work, acknowledging new followers, engaging others in conversation, and asking for advice. Use platform-specific promotion resources (see 'how to effectively promote your stories on Wattpad').

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultivate an engaged fanbase
rubrics_metrics.description: Build an engaged community of readers who repeatedly read and support your work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wattpad emphasizes helping creators cultivate diverse voices and build an engaged community — sustained engagement and relationship-building with readers is a primary route to success on the platform.

rubrics_metrics.name: Champion untold/diverse stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Wattpad champions untold stories to publishing and entertainment industries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The platform highlights and uplifts diverse, untold stories; creators whose work brings fresh or underrepresented perspectives align with Wattpad's promotion and partnership priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Story School and creator resources to improve craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn and grow through Wattpad's Story School and creator resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Story School features creators and experts from Wattpad HQ and provides tips to make your stories great. Writers are encouraged to watch Story School content and explore the Resource Library for craft and platform-specific guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid copyright infringement
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not use or distribute others' works without permission or post on behalf of an author without permission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples of infringement include adapting or making slight alterations to an existing work and posting it without permission. If you believe your work was infringed, follow Wattpad's 'Reporting Copyright Infringement' process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid plagiarism
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not incorporate someone else's work into your own without credit or permission, or present others' work or ideas as your own.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plagiarism includes both unattributed copying and using someone else's work without permission. Wattpad distinguishes plagiarism (presentation of others' work as your own) from copyright infringement (unauthorized use/distribution).

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand what copyright protects (and what it doesn't)
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright protects expression of an idea, but not the idea itself; it does not protect titles, similar plots or themes; it does protect images even if they are easy to locate online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Creators should be aware that similar plots or themes are not automatically infringement, but direct copying of expressive content (text, images) is. Protecting images even if readily found online is emphasized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Know monetization pathways on Wattpad
rubrics_metrics.description: Writers can earn through programs such as Wattpad Originals, Wattpad Creators Program, and Brand Partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wattpad Originals: select writers/stories are chosen to be part of the program, enabling writers to earn money and gain reader support. Brand Partnerships: Wattpad works with brands and studios to provide exclusive writing opportunities that increase exposure and can lead to earnings. Learn more via the program links for eligibility and application details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report copyright infringement via platform procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: If you want to submit a claim of copyright infringement, follow Wattpad's Reporting Copyright Infringement process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site links to a specific reporting page; creators are directed to use that process to submit claims rather than resolving disputes informally on the platform.
